auxilio.configuration.title: Auxilio Configs
auxilio.configuration.debugMouseTweaks.t: Log detailed mouse tweak actions and profiler markers.
auxilio.configuration.enableRepeatRightD: RMB drag places into empty or matching slots each time you hover them.
auxilio.configuration.enableSpreadSort.t: Middle-click sorting for crafting grid slots.
auxilio.configuration.enableShiftDragQui: Shift-drag left mouse to quick-move hovered stacks once per slot.
auxilio.configuration.enableShiftDoubleC: Shift + double left-click quick-moves all matching items from player inventory.
auxilio.configuration.enableScrollTransf: Scroll up/down to move one item between inventories.
auxilio.configuration.enableShiftScrollF: In furnace UIs, Shift + scroll prioritizes moving one hovered player-inventory item to fuel slot.
